name: io.github.PixFrixSystems/search-console-mcp
title: Google Search Console
description: Google Search Console data and SEO analysis: performance, quick wins, indexing and sitemaps.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google service account JSON key. Not needed after signing in with 'auth login'.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
environmentVariables.description: The service account JSON key itself, as a string, for hosts without a file system.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Default Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_BRAND_TERMS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated brand names, used to separate branded from non-branded search.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the tools that submit and remove sitemaps.
